mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for implementing AEO for an accounting firm?

acceptedAnswer.text: Implementing AEO for an accounting firm typically involves several steps. First, we conduct thorough keyword research to identify common questions potential clients ask about accounting services. Next, we audit your existing website content to identify gaps and areas for optimization, focusing on direct answer formats. Content creation or revision then ensures your pages provide clear, concise answers. Finally, technical optimizations are applied to help search engines easily understand and extract your information. Ongoing monitoring and adjustments keep your firm visible as search technologies evolve.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO implementation for accounting firms involves keyword research, content audits, creation of direct answer content, technical optimization, and ongoing monitoring.
